verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's public pricing page lists tiers (Starter, Pro, Enterprise) and their feature sets. The Starter tier caps users at 3 and projects at 1 while offering unlimited flags, experiments and traffic, which suggests cost is driven by seats rather than MAUs, events or requests. The evidence contains no actual price figures, and the per-seat cost model is only implied. Missing for 10: published dollar amounts per tier, an explicit per-seat or usage pricing formula, Pro/Enterprise seat limits, and independent corroboration of how billing works in practice.
